# The Examined Classroom

Official site: https://examinedclassroom.com/

The Examined Classroom is the personal website of Matthew A. Zinn, a philosopher and educator working across moral psychology, AI ethics, philosophy of education, and educational technology.

The site publishes classroom-ready thought experiments, educator resources, research-backed AI ethics guidance, and practical AI tools for K-12 teachers, school leaders, students, and families.
